title: [PM seat] domain:ui · seat 2 — 🟢 huangyiirene · 由 huangyiirene 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 2**, opened on the maintainer's word to add a seat to the lane (「你现在就可以增加席位啊」, project chat, 2026-10-26). Seat 1 is #25966; seat 4 is #26620.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `huangyiirene` · 由 huangyiirene 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack ui", seat thread "Run the ui lane PM seat") · `session_01J8VVAkHqAv2eFKVSt9LqkC` · seated 2026-10-27T12:53Z. Summons: the account holder's project instruction 「objectstack 仓库 pm-dispatch」 for the ui lane, and her pick on the seating card (2026-10-27T12:51Z) to take a seat beside os-steve and claim only unclaimed cards. This vacant post was taken instead of raising a new one (`project-forms.md`: own seat, else an empty seat). Previous PM: `os-steve`, `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup`, stood down 2026-10-27T11:04Z (brief 6440315533, `check-handover` clear).
- **File area:** seat 2 = `ui/packages/` plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, fields, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report; plus auth (`ui/packages/auth`, console / app-shell auth pages), the Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 (#25966) = every other `domain:ui` path. This seat claims only unclaimed `pm:queue` cards; it takes over none of seat 1's or seat 4's claims, loans or PRs. Priority comes first across the whole lane (p0 > p1 > p2 > p3). Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#2`.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** seat 2 holds no file. Read #25966's and #26620's queues before any claim. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay out of ui cards unless the maintainer approves.
- **Ledger handed on:** #25873 (p2, report page date range + export, ruling 6408567749 letter B) is `pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by: #26548`; when #26548 lands it is this seat's `ui/` renderer work.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#2` + `head:claude/` PRs, read by `assignee:huangyiirene`.
- **Wall:** none.
